body_excerpt:
It was discovered that Atril did not properly sanitize command-line
arguments in PDF /GoToR actions. If a user opened a specially crafted PDF
file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2026-46529)

It was discovered that Atril incorrectly handled certain PDF files. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or
to execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.
(CVE-2019-1010006)

Andy Nguyen discovered that Atril incorrectly handled certain images. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to expose sensitive information.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2019-11459)
